behavior: Active bark-forager that moves rapidly headfirst down, upward, and sideways along trunks and branches; probes bark crevices for insects and seeds, caches food, and has short, bouncy flight.
field_marks: Black crown with a bold black stripe through the eye
Broad white eyebrow and pale white face
Blue-gray back and wings with darker flight feathers
Rusty cinnamon breast, belly, and flanks
Long, straight, sharply pointed gray bill
Compact body with dark legs and a very short, square-tipped tail
habitat: Primarily mature coniferous and mixed forests, especially stands containing spruce, fir, pine, hemlock, or larch; may use other wooded habitats outside the breeding season.
